study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized cerebellar damage predicts the presence of behavioral disorders in children with brainstem tumors

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Healthy controls were aggregated from multiple sources (local Beijing recruitment and Guangzhou Children's Hospital) plus publicly available FCON and CCNP; patients were enrolled at Beijing Tiantan Hospital.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "A cohort of 171 pediatric patients (age range: 4 -17 years) diagnosed with brainstem tumors at the Department of Neurosurgery, Beijing Tiantan Hospital..."; "data from 849 healthy children (age range: 4 -18 years) were collected from publicly available databases, including 72 locally recruited children in Beijing... 69 from the fcon_1000.projects dataset... 450 from the Child Connectome Project (CCNP) ... and 269 from the Children ' s Hospital in Guangzhou."

answer.FCON: healthy controls for normative model development (10-fold CV and definitive model)

answer.devCCNP: healthy controls for normative model development (10-fold CV and definitive model)

answer.MULTI-SITE (N\u003e\u003d2): healthy controls from Beijing and Guangzhou contributing to normative model development

answer.SINGLE-SITE: patient cohort for deviation analysis and behavioral prediction

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative GPR models were estimated on healthy children with 10-fold cross-validation and then finalized for deviation analysis in patients.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "data from 849 healthy children ... including 72 locally recruited children in Beijing... 69 from the fcon_1000.projects dataset... 450 from the Child Connectome Project (CCNP) ... and 269 from the Children ' s Hospital in Guangzhou."; "Using volumetric data from the 26 cerebellar regions, we established normative models with Gaussian Process Regression (GPR)... We initially estimated models with 10-fold cross-validation on the healthy children dataset, then developed definitive models for deviation analysis in patients."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Jia2025.pdf.md: Participants, Paragraph 2; Methods / Normative modeling, Paragraph 1
